name: Insulin glargine
description: A long-acting basal insulin analogue that precipitates at physiological pH to give a flat 24-hour profile, approved for type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

systems.note: Replaces basal insulin; the labelled indication.
Insulin drives potassium intracellularly; hypokalaemia is labelled.
Weight gain is a labelled effect of insulin therapy.

monitors.why: Basal insulin is titrated against the fasting value.
Distinguishes endogenous secretion from the injected analogue, which C-peptide assays do not detect.
